description: This file provides a helper function for URL resolution related to specific API endpoints, particularly handling the 'user-organizations' endpoint by directing it to an external domain while leaving other URLs within the provided base URL.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Resolves a full URL for authentication-related endpoints, applying a special case for '/api/auth/user-organizations' to use an external domain.
